contract: Capability + trigger probes for the NIETE mock WhatsApp E2E lane. An agent starting at SKILL.md, opening reference/ only when the dispatch table points there, must answer each probe with every must_contain fact. Trigger probes check the skill fires on phrasings that never say 'mock lane' and does NOT fire for the paused chrome lane.

probes.question: The Gherkin tests got generated on my PR but the qa-impact comment still says E2E recorded: missing. Other operators see the same. What is wrong?
must_contain: impact.py counts a runs.jsonl row only if it was ADDED in the PR's commit range on the remote
ledger_row.py auto-commits and pushes the row, but skips on detached HEAD, a protected branch (sandbox/staging/main/develop), no upstream, or a refused push — the run's `ledger:` line says which
the workflow runs only on PRs into sandbox

probes.question: keys/niete-local.env is missing on a teammate's laptop even though they ran railway login. Why, and how do they fix it?
must_contain: the account must be a member of the "NIETE-Rumi Staging" Railway project — login alone is not access
provision-local-keys.sh reads service bot in both the sandbox and staging environments
run bash bot/scripts/e2e/provision-local-keys.sh by hand and read the exit code (5 = no Railway access)

probes.question: How do I run the mock E2E for just the lesson-plan feature on my current commit?
must_contain: bash .claude/qa/shared/commit-e2e.sh HEAD --features lesson-plan, from a NIETE-Rumi worktree
exit 0 means it ran; verdicts are in the printed rows

probes.question: A coaching scenario PASSed but the row is CRITICAL with cassette misses. Can I call it green?
must_contain: no — a PASS under cassette.scenarios_affected is not evidence (error path)
record with --record or --record-missing using keys/niete-record.env; never hand-write a cassette

probes.question: commit-e2e.sh exited 3 and the run log shows local-stack.sh exit 13. What does that mean?
must_contain: /health reported a different commit than asked — the branch lacks build-info.js / the /health commit field (not sandbox-based)

probes.question: Run the WhatsApp Web E2E for registration against staging with the linked browser.
must_contain: this is the chrome lane (/niete-e2e), paused unless E2E_CHROME_ON=1 — not this skill
